name: kn-vat-and-import-charges
description: Saint Kitts and Nevis VAT for 2026 under the Value Added Tax Act, Cap. 18.47: the 17% standard rate (13% from 1 January to 30 June 2025, back to 17% on 1 July 2025), the 10% rate for hotel accommodation, commercial rentals and restaurants, the 5% discounted VAT rate days in 2026, registration above EC$150,000 (EC$96,000 for leases and professional services), monthly returns within 15 days, input tax rules, records for six years, and import VAT on customs value plus duty, other charges and the 6% Customs Service Charge, with the 2026 customs relief measures. Trigger phrases include St Kitts VAT, Nevis VAT rate, VAT registration threshold St Kitts, import duty St Kitts, customs service charge.
